reported_totals.request_counting: v1 recorded requests = measures + clear_attempts + int(started) + int(user_exit); parameter/state prevalidation rejection attempts are not fully counted
reported_totals.rules: Frozen unit/nominal checks are not candidate policy executions; source reading, synthetic geometry CPU, assembly and audit overhead are not inside evaluation_wall_s
reported_totals.timing: Wall and per-case runtimes were gathered under concurrent workloads, not controlled benchmark latency or official runtime

A1.request_count_semantics: Recorded local requests derived from measure/clear counters plus enter/normal exit. Batch rows.requests omits prevalidation or state-rejected attempts; without a full attempt journal it cannot exclude unrecorded rejected attempts. Diagnostic request counts retain their author's reconstruction caveats.

execution_costs.semantics: Actual local requests include enter/measure/clear/exit, with repeats counted. Summed batch wall time excludes literature, geometry, rules, analysis and orchestration; not total elapsed project time.

A2.request_count_semantics: Recorded local requests, not a complete attempt ledger: saved batch rows.requests excludes prevalidation or state-rejected attempts. No full-attempt precision is claimed for these historical batches.

evidence_boundary: Saved rows are independently recomputed for IDs, T/cleared, completeness and per-mode/group means; source bytes are SHA256-bound. No strategy/environment execution, old-statistic rewrite, new holdout, official test or new RL training.
read_order: Read the legacy indexes, then this standalone S6 increment. Only nodes listed by this index are active; counts exclude packaging, drafts, revision duplicates, geometry and synthetic tests from algorithm full-round totals.

A1 R1：Task-cost gate for known-channel measurements while at discovery stations

A1 R5：Remove R4 expanded route choices; retain cross-channel information score

A1 R6B：Same R6 mechanism with missing time import repaired; not a new direction or independent algorithm round
A1 R7：Rotate future unscanned sites jointly to fit a certified paid stop
A1 R8：Fixed visited sites/paid anchor with up to four minimax Voronoi updates and station-only path guard
A1 R9：Keep R7 rotation priority, then R8 constrained minimax fallback
A1 R10：After R9 proposals fail, rotate future sites toward the paid anchor and run the same four constrained minimax updates

A1 R12：Retain R11 incoming candidate and add a certified move toward its projection on the current-position/route-successor segment; choose by two-edge Euclidean route cost
A1 R13：Damp R11's maximum certified station displacement by one half, then recertify; retain geometric slack rather than hugging the constraint
